title: Multivariate energy-weighted Q3 source bound
question: Does A(q,v)=1+q^4+v^4 absorb the actual Q3 source polynomial in both spatial orientations for every real q,v and |a|<=1/4?

weighted_target.reason: Every monomial has field degree i+j<=3 and source degree k; |q|^i|v|^j <= A^(3/4) and |a|^k <= (1/4)^k.

finite_fixture.check_role: exact fourth-power self-tests; the all-real inequality is the coefficient-majorant argument

scope.not_closed: The result is a pointwise commutative polynomial majorant. It does not construct the Q3 operator common core, prove domain invariance, or control products and spatial histories.

adversarial_review.check: The all-real estimate is attributed to the coefficient majorant and monomial degree bounds; the 98 grid points are exact self-tests only.
Center and source-at-neighbor polynomials are reconstructed separately and receive separate coefficient sums.
The bound assumes |a|<=1/4 exactly as declared; no unrestricted source amplitude is inferred.
The pointwise commuting bound is not called a Q3 operator/domain theorem or a central-context estimate.
C=122099/35840 is recomputed from all polynomial coefficients and source powers in both arithmetic lanes.
R236 checks exact coefficient and orientation fixtures only, not unbounded domains or history convergence.
No factorial incidence, KMS/OS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.
No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

qft_interface.closed: A pointwise multivariate energy-weighted coefficient majorant for the actual Q3 source in both orientations under |a|<=1/4.
qft_interface.open: The Q3 common-core realization, domain invariance, weighted product/history bound, factorial spatial incidence, first passage, exhaustion, common alpha, KMS/OS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing multivariate scalar interface. It is stronger than the slice bound but remains pointwise and commutative.
next_action: Connect this pointwise majorant to an actual Q3 common energy domain and prove a multiplicative weighted history estimate before attempting the factorial spatial incidence and common-alpha gates.
